name: Cable Squat
instructions: Set the cable handles on a low setting and stand far enough from the machine to keep light tension throughout the movement.
Stand with your feet around shoulder width, brace your torso, and keep the handles in a comfortable position without letting the stack pull you forward.
Sit the hips down and back while bending the knees. Keep the knees tracking over the toes and maintain a controlled, neutral-spine position.
Drive through the mid-foot to stand tall, then repeat without letting the weight stack slam.

name: Cable Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Attach handles or a straight-bar attachment to a low cable and stand tall with the resistance in front of your thighs.
Keep a small bend in the knees, brace your trunk, and push the hips backward while keeping the spine neutral.
Lower only as far as you can maintain control and feel a strong hamstring stretch without rounding the back.
Drive the hips forward to return to standing and finish with the glutes rather than leaning backward.

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand a comfortable stride in front of a bench and place the top of the rear foot on the bench. Hold dumbbells at your sides if using load.
Keep most of your pressure through the front foot and lower under control by bending the front knee and hip.
Descend until you reach a comfortable depth while keeping the front knee tracking with the toes and the pelvis controlled.
Drive through the front foot to return to the start, complete the set, then switch legs.

name: Cable Leg Curl
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable and secure it around one ankle. Hold the machine or another stable support for balance.
Stand tall with the working thigh kept mostly still and the knee slightly behind or directly under the hip.
Flex the knee to bring the heel toward the glute without swinging the hip or arching the lower back.
Pause briefly, lower the foot slowly against the cable tension, complete the set, then switch legs.
